objective: One-update-free four-A100 integration check for invertible headwise rotary address-value binding inside RWKV-MS.

authorization_basis.stopping_rule: The bilinear output-coupling family is retired; rotary binding is the separately locked fallback.

architecture.write: Apply block-diagonal two-coordinate rotations to RWKV v after existing address-conditioned feature transforms and before the recurrent state scan.
architecture.read: Apply the inverse query-address rotations to the aggregated RWKV matrix read immediately before HRM group normalization and output projection.

training.open_fit_rows_only: one inherited open-fit schedule row per rank
training.random_projection: fresh deterministic orthogonal phase maps, seed 115

stopping_rule.pass: Authorize a separately signed eight-update causal rotary endpoint; generation remains blocked until its held-out donor and phase-separation gates pass.
stopping_rule.fail: Retire headwise rotary binding; do not tune gain, batch size, learning rate, or duration.
stopping_rule.always: Do not open publisher validation/test, Hard32, or strength holdouts; do not save adapter weights.
